turns.question: What was the median, across the ten long-standing customers, of each customer's total non-cancelled order amount from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no median metric (median order value is not available here) and no per-customer breakdown or customer-group filter to isolate ten long-standing customers, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (sum of non-cancelled order amounts), average_order_value_eur, and customers_distinct (active customers); I ran no query, so there is no freshness statement.
